name: Lucian
title: the Purifier

Q.name: Piercing Light
Q.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing 90/130/170/210/250 + 1×bonus AD physical damage.
Q.summary: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

W.name: Ardent Blaze
W.description: Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing 75/110/145/180/215 + 0.9×AP magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds. When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains 60/65/70/75/80 Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.
W.summary: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

E.name: Relentless Pursuit
E.description: Lucian dashes. Cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger (2 seconds for champions).
E.summary: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

R.name: The Culling
R.description: Lucian rapidly fires ((1 + (1×crit × (1×stat + -1)))) × 22 shots in a direction for 3 seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals 15/30/45 + 0.25×AD + 0.15×AP physical damage to the first enemy hit. While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit. Total Damage: (((1 + (1×crit × (1×stat + -1)))) × 22) × (15/30/45 + 0.25×AD + 0.15×AP) physical damage
R.summary: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

Passive.name: Lightslinger
Passive.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.
Passive.summary: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Short-range burst marksman who weaves double-shot autos between abilities and dashes in. Dominates early lanes and skirmishes, fades late.
strengths: Strong level 1–3 with passive double shots
E dash for trades and dodges
profile.curveNote: Trades from level 1 with passive double shots.

E.notes: Short dash; cooldown lowered by passive hits.
